notes: Read all 103 source lines with line numbers before porting. Imports (L1-2): react useId is kept; useRef + the typed `KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>` + the lucide-free cn() Tailwind composer are DOM-only and replaced by RN primitives (View/Pressable/StyleSheet), AppText, and theme tokens. The TabItem interface (L4-8: key/label/disabled?) and TabsProps (L10-17: tabs/activeTab/onChange/className/ariaLabel) are preserved verbatim except `className` -> `style` (StyleProp<ViewStyle>) and an added native `testID`. The component doc comment (L19-31) is reflected in the native header + JSDoc.

Selection behaviour preserved 1:1: the component signature/destructure (L32) keeps tabs/activeTab/onChange/ariaLabel; useId() (L33) is retained as `tablistId` and feeds each tab's nativeID `${tablistId}-tab-${tab.key}` (L75); the container map over `tabs` and the `selected = activeTab === tab.key` test (L70-71) are unchanged; the web `onClick={() => onChange(tab.key)}` (L86) becomes `onPress={() => onChange(tab.key)}`. The web `<div role=tablist aria-label>` (L65-69) maps to View accessibilityRole='tablist' + accessibilityLabel={ariaLabel}; the `<button role=tab aria-selected disabled>` (L80-85) maps to Pressable accessibilityRole='tab' + accessibilityState={{selected, disabled}} + `disabled={tab.disabled}`; the visible `{tab.label}` (L97) renders in an AppText.

Roving keyboard navigation (L34 refs map, L36 enabledKeys, L38-44 moveFocus with onChange + requestAnimationFrame focus, L46-62 handleKeyDown for ArrowLeft/ArrowRight wrap-around + Home/End + skip-disabled, and the L84 roving tabIndex / L87 onKeyDown wiring) has no touch analog and — consistent with this repo's TimelineScrubber/EditableText ports — is not wired to a rendered key event. Its exact arithmetic is preserved verbatim in the exported, unit-tested `getNextEnabledTabKey(enabledKeys, currentKey, key)` helper (ArrowRight=+1 / ArrowLeft=-1 with modulo wrap-around, Home=first, End=last, empty=>null, unknown-current arrow=>null mirroring the `idx === -1` guard). Native instead surfaces every tab as an independent accessibility element (swipe + double-tap to activate), and activation stays immediate (caller fires onChange with the returned key) matching the web's automatic activation.

DOM-only details with no RN equivalent are dropped and documented (rule 7): `aria-controls={`${tablistId}-panel-${tab.key}`}` (L83) has no cross-element control association in RN — the component still does not own the tab panels, so the panel id is omitted while the tab `nativeID` (L75) is kept so consumer panels can still link back; the roving `tabIndex` (L84), the `requestAnimationFrame` focus defer (L41-43), the per-tab `ref` map (L34/L76-79) and the HTMLButtonElement-typed handlers are desktop-keyboard/focus concerns folded into the helper; `type='button'` (L80) is implicit for Pressable; `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500` + `transition-colors` (L89-90) and `cursor-not-allowed` (L94) have no RN analog.

cn() Tailwind classes + CSS-var tokens (L66, L88-95) became StyleSheet styles + theme tokens: the container `flex gap-1 border-b border-gray-200/dark:border-gray-700` -> flexDirection row + gap spacing.xs + a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08) bottom hairline; the active `border-b-2 border-blue-600/dark:border-blue-400 text-blue-600/dark:text-blue-400` -> a 2px colors.accent bottom border + colors.accent label (every tab reserves a transparent 2px bottom border so selecting never shifts height); inactive `text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:text-gray-700` -> colors.textMuted with a pressed opacity dim (RN has no :hover); `px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium` -> paddingHorizontal 16 / paddingVertical 8 / fontSize 14 / fontWeight '500'; `disabled && opacity-50` -> opacity 0.5. The closing map/return/JSX (L98-103) carries no behaviour. No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, old web UI imports, API paths, or unit conversions were introduced.
